overview: Six amethyst blocks make a door. Open it and you are inside a hollow geode of your own that nobody else can reach, and the door on the far side puts you back exactly where you left.

1.1.1: Sharing a geode arrives as a prompt with Accept and Deny, not two lines of chat.
Left alone it lapses and takes itself away.
An advancement for the first time you step through a door of your own.
1.1.0: Geodes grow into one another. /geode join asks another player to share.
Their room is cut beside yours with a door of its own, chests carried across intact.
The two hollows open where the crystal walls meet.
1.0.0: A door of amethyst, and behind it a geode cut for you the first time you open one.
Basalt skin, calcite rind, amethyst you can see, some of it budding, and a crystal floor.
Buds and clusters count as shell, so the room stays a room rather than a shard farm.
What it drops comes through the game's own loot tables.
